boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Denison University
boards.description: Granville's quiet village charm meets late-night student life through on-campus hubs and nearby Newark essentials that keep the Hill fueled after hours.

cards.title: Slayter Market
cards.subtitle: Campus Center Level, Slayter Union
cards.notes: Visit the Broad Street Grill inside for burgers and wraps. It is the primary late-night food hub on the Hill during the academic year.
cards.short_summary: The central on-campus late-night dining destination featuring the Broad Street Grill.
cards.evidence_claim: Slayter Market features the Broad Street Grill and is a key campus dining location for students.
cards.source_title: Locations - Denison Dining Services
cards.access_notes: Open late during the academic semester; check the Grubhub app for current nightly closing times.

cards.title: Common Grounds
cards.subtitle: Slayter Hall Student Union
cards.notes: Grab a coffee or frozen drink for late-night study sessions. This cafe provides a social atmosphere in the heart of the student union.
cards.short_summary: A student-centric coffee shop located within the Slayter Hall Student Union.
cards.evidence_claim: Common Grounds is located on the campus center level of Slayter Union and offers coffee options.
cards.source_title: Locations - Denison Dining Services
cards.access_notes: Hours vary by semester; typically open for evening study and social hours.

cards.title: The Nest
cards.subtitle: Slayter Hall Student Union
cards.notes: Order flatbreads and specialty items through the Grubhub app. It serves as a popular alternative for evening meals on campus.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus dining spot in Slayter Hall known for flatbreads and mobile ordering.
cards.evidence_claim: The Nest is located in Slayter Hall and offers flatbreads and mobile ordering via Grubhub.
cards.source_title: Locations - Denison Dining Services
cards.access_notes: Check the Denison Dining website for specific evening hours during the school year.

cards.title: Late-Night Breakfast at Huffman
cards.subtitle: The Table at Huffman
cards.notes: Attend scheduled late-night breakfast events for food and games. These university-sponsored events are a staple of finals week and special occasions.
cards.short_summary: A recurring university event featuring breakfast food and social activities late at night.
cards.evidence_claim: Denison Dining hosts Late-night Breakfast events at Huffman Dining Hall until 12 am.
cards.source_title: Late-night Breakfast - Denison Dining Services
cards.access_notes: Typically held from 10 pm to 12 am on specific event dates.

cards.title: Late-Night Breakfast at Curtis
cards.subtitle: The Table at Curtis
cards.notes: Join the community for late-night pancakes and board games. This event provides a high-energy break from late-night studying.
cards.short_summary: A popular late-night breakfast event held at Curtis Dining Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Curtis Dining Hall hosts Late Night Breakfast events from 10 pm to 12 am.
cards.source_title: Late Night Breakfast - Denison Dining Services
cards.access_notes: Event-based; usually scheduled during exam periods or special campus weekends.

cards.title: Whit's Frozen Custard
cards.subtitle: 226 E Broadway
cards.notes: Walk down the hill for a signature 'Whitser' or a scoop of the flavor of the week. It is a quintessential Granville evening tradition.
cards.short_summary: The original location of the famous frozen custard shop, located in downtown Granville.
cards.evidence_claim: Whit's Frozen Custard in Granville is the original home and is open daily until 9 pm.
cards.source_title: Ohio - Granville | Whit's Frozen Custard
cards.access_notes: Open daily until 9 pm; often has lines of students on warm evenings.

cards.title: Day Y Noche
cards.subtitle: 134 E Broadway
cards.notes: Stop by for nachos or quesadillas in the heart of the village. It is one of the few downtown spots serving food until 9 pm or later.
cards.short_summary: A local Mexican restaurant in downtown Granville popular for evening meals.
cards.evidence_claim: Day Y Noche is open until 9 pm most nights and 10 pm on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.source_title: Day Y Noche: Home
cards.access_notes: Open until 9 pm Monday-Thursday and 10 pm on Friday-Saturday.

cards.title: Taco Bell (Newark)
cards.subtitle: 1091 N 21st St
cards.notes: Drive to nearby Newark for a late-night taco run. The drive-thru remains open well past midnight for those with off-campus transportation.
cards.short_summary: A reliable late-night fast food option located a short drive from campus in Newark.
cards.evidence_claim: The Taco Bell at 1091 N 21st St in Newark has drive-thru hours until 1 am daily.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell® in Newark, OH - 1091 N 21st St
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru open until 1 am daily; dining room closes earlier at midnight.

cards.title: Sheetz (Newark)
cards.subtitle: 815 N 21st St
cards.notes: Order Made-To-Order snacks at any hour of the night. This 24/7 spot is the ultimate destination for students needing food in the early morning.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour convenience store and eatery in Newark frequently visited by Denison students.
cards.evidence_claim: Sheetz provides Made-To-Order food and beverages 24/7/365.
cards.source_title: Sheetz
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

cards.title: CVS Pharmacy
cards.subtitle: 200 E Broadway
cards.notes: Pick up snacks, drinks, or basic groceries until 10 pm. It is the most convenient spot in the village for late-evening essentials.
cards.short_summary: A pharmacy and convenience store in downtown Granville open until late evening.
cards.evidence_claim: The CVS at 200 E. Broadway in Granville is open until 10 pm daily.
cards.source_title: CVS Pharmacy at 200 E. Broadway Granville, OH 43023
cards.access_notes: Store and photo services are open until 10 pm; pharmacy hours are shorter.

boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Discover the specific study nooks, social lounges, and outdoor retreats that Denison students use to navigate daily life on The Hill.

cards.entity_name: Samson Talbot Hall of Biological Science
cards.title: Talbot Hall Upper Floor Windows
cards.subtitle: Quiet study areas with panoramic views
cards.notes: Head to the 5th or 6th floor corner windows for tables with expansive views of Granville. It is a preferred spot for quiet work during sunset when the valley colors change.
cards.short_summary: Upper-floor window seating in Talbot Hall offers quiet study spaces with some of the best views of the surrounding Granville landscape.
cards.evidence_claim: The 5th and 6th floors of Talbot Hall feature tables and seating areas in corner windows showcasing Granville scenery.
cards.source_title: My Top 5 Study Spots at Denison - Her Campus
cards.access_notes: Open during academic building hours; accessible to students with ID.

cards.title: The Beach Patio
cards.subtitle: Outdoor gathering spot between Sawyer and Beaver
cards.notes: This concrete patio is a central outdoor hangout for sunset watching and group study. Despite the name, there is no sand, but it remains a primary social landmark on West Quad.
cards.short_summary: A popular concrete patio located between Sawyer and Beaver Halls used for outdoor socializing and sunset viewing.
cards.evidence_claim: The Beach is a cement patio area between Sawyer and Beaver halls known as a top spot for watching the sunset.
cards.source_title: My Top 5 Study Spots at Denison - Her Campus
cards.access_notes: Outdoor public campus space; accessible 24/7.

cards.title: Slivy's Fireplace Lounge
cards.subtitle: Cozy study nook in Silverstein Hall
cards.notes: Located on the ground floor of Silverstein Hall, this lounge features a fireplace and couches. It is a quieter alternative to Slayter for late-night snacks and comfortable study.
cards.short_summary: A cozy lounge area with a fireplace located within Slivy's Cafe in Silverstein Hall, favored for its peaceful atmosphere.
cards.evidence_claim: Slivy's Cafe in Silverstein Hall features a lounge with couches and a fireplace used by students for studying.
cards.source_title: Slivy's - Denison Dining Services
cards.access_notes: Accessible during cafe operating hours; check Denison Dining for current late-night schedule.

cards.entity_name: Ann and Thomas Hoaglin Wellness Center
cards.title: Hoaglin Meditation Garden
cards.subtitle: Secluded outdoor seating behind the center
cards.notes: Find the high-rise tables and seating in the garden area behind the Wellness Center. It is a quiet, plant-filled retreat designed for recharging away from high-traffic quads.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor meditation garden and seating area located behind the Hoaglin Wellness Center, offering a quiet space for reflection.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hoaglin Wellness Center includes an outdoor meditation garden and several seating areas designed for student well-being.
cards.source_title: Wellness Center - Denison University
cards.access_notes: Outdoor garden area is generally accessible; building interior follows Wellness Center hours.

cards.title: Slayter Third Floor Lounge
cards.subtitle: Central hub for student organizations
cards.notes: While the first floor is for dining, the third floor offers expansive open spaces for meetings and events. It was formerly a bowling alley and now serves as a major social hub.
cards.short_summary: The third floor of Slayter Union provides flexible open spaces for student interaction, organization meetings, and campus events.
cards.evidence_claim: Slayter Union's third floor is an event and gathering space that formerly housed bowling lanes.
cards.source_title: Slayter Hall Student Union | Campus Map - Denison University
cards.access_notes: Open during student union hours, typically late into the evening.

cards.title: Burton Morgan Atrium
cards.subtitle: Modern collaboration and breakout spaces
cards.notes: The three-story atrium features perimeter social spaces and small breakout rooms. It is a high-transparency environment ideal for group projects and networking with alumni.
cards.short_summary: A modern three-story atrium in the Burton D. Morgan Center featuring collaboration spaces and breakout rooms for students.
cards.evidence_claim: The Burton D. Morgan Center features an atrium with social spaces on the perimeter and breakout rooms for collaborative work.
cards.source_title: Designed to foster ideas and imagination - GUND Partnership
cards.access_notes: Open during administrative and academic hours.

cards.title: Mulberry Computer Lab
cards.subtitle: Specialized lab for fine arts students
cards.notes: Located in Mulberry House, this 17-seat lab is a dedicated resource for students in fine arts disciplines, offering specialized software and a focused creative environment.
cards.short_summary: A specialized 17-seat computer lab in Mulberry House dedicated to students in the fine arts disciplines.
cards.evidence_claim: Mulberry House contains a computer lab with a 17-seat capacity for teaching and working in fine arts disciplines.
cards.source_title: Facilities | Visual Arts - Denison University
cards.access_notes: Primarily for fine arts students; check department for general access policies.

cards.entity_name: Michael D. Eisner Center for the Performing Arts
cards.title: Eisner Center Collaboration Spaces
cards.subtitle: Interdisciplinary interaction zones
cards.notes: The Eisner Center is designed with numerous open spaces specifically configured to encourage interaction between dance, music, and theatre students outside of formal rehearsals.
cards.short_summary: Open, interdisciplinary spaces within the Eisner Center designed to foster collaboration across the performing arts.
cards.evidence_claim: The Eisner Center houses many open spaces especially configured to encourage interdisciplinary activity among students.
cards.source_title: Facilities | Music - Denison University
cards.access_notes: Open during performing arts center hours.

cards.title: Moon Hall Social Spaces
cards.subtitle: Flexible student lodge on North Quad
cards.notes: This social lodge features four flexible interior spaces named after moon phases (e.g., New Moon, Crescent Moon). It is a primary venue for student-run social events and gatherings.
cards.short_summary: A student social lodge on North Quad featuring four flexible interior spaces for gatherings and events.
cards.evidence_claim: Moon Hall is a social lodge for students on North Quad with four flexible interior spaces named New Moon, Crescent Moon, etc.
cards.source_title: Moon Hall | Campus Map - Denison University
cards.access_notes: Available for student use and organization rentals.

cards.title: Curtis West Common Room
cards.subtitle: Traditional study space with a fireplace
cards.notes: This common room features paneled walls and a cozy fireplace, offering a quintessential collegiate atmosphere for studying. It is a quieter, more traditional alternative to modern labs.
cards.short_summary: A traditional common room in Curtis West Hall featuring wood paneling and a fireplace, used for quiet study.
cards.evidence_claim: Curtis West Hall contains a quintessential common room with paneled walls, couches, study areas, and a cozy fireplace.
cards.source_title: Campus Map | Denison University
cards.access_notes: Located within a residence hall; accessible to residents and their guests.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Explore Denison University and Granville without spending a dime. From expansive nature reserves and art galleries to student-led social hubs, these spots offer free access for students and the public.

cards.title: Hike the Bio Reserve
cards.subtitle: 350-acre nature preserve
cards.notes: Explore over 350 acres of beech-maple forests and orchards. The well-marked trail system is open to the public from dawn to dusk daily for hiking and birdwatching.
cards.short_summary: A massive 350-acre nature preserve with extensive hiking trails open daily to the public.
cards.evidence_claim: The Bio Reserve is open to the public from dawn to dusk every day. A well-marked trail system has been established that allows the visitor to explore a variety of habitats.
cards.source_title: Biological Reserve | Sustainability - Denison University
cards.access_notes: Open daily from dawn to dusk. Located a quarter mile north of campus on Rt. 661.

cards.title: Browse the Denison Museum
cards.subtitle: Art and cultural collections
cards.notes: Visit the Michael D. Eisner Center to see rotating exhibits from a collection of over 9,000 objects. Admission is free for students and the general public.
cards.short_summary: A campus art and culture museum featuring over 9,000 objects with free admission for all.
cards.evidence_claim: The Denison Museum's exhibitions and events are free and open to the general public.
cards.source_title: Plan your visit | Denison Museum
cards.access_notes: Located on the ground level of the Eisner Center. Check website for seasonal academic break closures.

cards.title: Work Out at Mitchell Center
cards.subtitle: Campus fitness and recreation
cards.notes: Students can use the fitness center, Olympic-sized pool, and indoor track at no extra cost. It is a hub for both varsity athletes and casual student recreation.
cards.short_summary: A comprehensive athletic facility where students enjoy free access to gyms, pools, and tracks.
cards.evidence_claim: At Denison there is no extra cost, and you don't have to be an athlete to use the gym, the pool, or the other facilities.
cards.source_title: Is the gym at college free? - Denison University
cards.access_notes: Free for current students with ID. Open during standard facility hours.

cards.title: Lounge at The HILL
cards.subtitle: Student organization hub
cards.notes: Gather with student groups in this renovated basement space in Huffman Hall. It features conference rooms and a common area designed for collaboration.
cards.short_summary: A student-funded lounge in Huffman Hall designed for club meetings and social collaboration.
cards.evidence_claim: The Huffman Innovation Leadership Lounge — HILL for short — and design it as a hub for student groups. It opened on Jan. 17.
cards.source_title: 'A space for everyone' opens in Huffman Hall | Denison University
cards.access_notes: Located in the basement of Huffman Hall. Primarily accessible to student organization leaders via swipe.

cards.title: Hang Out in Slayter Union
cards.subtitle: The center of campus life
cards.notes: Relax in the open gathering spaces of Slayter Hall. This 24/7 hub is the primary spot for students to connect, check mail, or grab a snack between classes.
cards.short_summary: The central student union building offering 24/7 social spaces and campus services.
cards.evidence_claim: Open 24/7, Denison students frequently find themselves in Slayter eating, learning, and connecting.
cards.source_title: Resources - Academic Catalog - Denison University
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 for students. Includes lounges, a market, and the bookstore.

cards.title: View Art at Bryant Center
cards.subtitle: Student and alumni galleries
cards.notes: Head to the 4th floor to see the Bryant Art Gallery. This 300-square-foot space showcases work from visiting artists, alumni, and BFA senior shows.
cards.short_summary: A creative hub featuring student and professional art galleries on the fourth floor.
cards.evidence_claim: The Bryant Art gallery, a 300 square foot space is on the 4th floor and is often used for classes, as well as visiting artists, alumni artists.
cards.source_title: Facilities | Visual Arts - Denison University
cards.access_notes: Galleries are typically open during building hours. Located on the 4th floor.

cards.title: Attend a Swasey Chapel Event
cards.subtitle: Historic campus landmark
cards.notes: Experience a concert or guest lecture in this iconic 1924 chapel. Most arts and speaker events held here are free and open to the public.
cards.short_summary: An iconic campus chapel hosting free concerts, lectures, and major academic ceremonies.
cards.evidence_claim: Most arts events at Denison are free and open to the public... Other venues: Denison Museum; Swasey Chapel.
cards.source_title: Arts Visitors Guide | Arts at Denison
cards.access_notes: Open for scheduled events. Check the Arts at Denison calendar for free performances.

cards.title: Visit The Homestead
cards.subtitle: Sustainable living community
cards.notes: Walk out to this student-run intentional community focused on ecological sustainability. It serves as a living-learning lab for sustainable lifestyles.
cards.short_summary: A unique, student-run sustainable living community that welcomes visitors interested in ecology.
cards.evidence_claim: The Homestead is a living-learning experience... Homesteaders also work to promote their projects, lifestyle, and ideals to non-members.
cards.source_title: Homestead | Denison University
cards.access_notes: Located on the periphery of campus. Visitors are encouraged to connect with residents for tours.

cards.title: Socialize at Moon Hall
cards.subtitle: North Quad social lodge
cards.notes: Utilize this social lodge on North Quad for student gatherings. It features open layouts and kitchens, often used for campus-wide social events.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated social lodge on North Quad used for student events and casual gatherings.
cards.evidence_claim: Moon Hall is a social lodge for Denison students, set on the North Quad.
cards.source_title: Moon Hall | Campus Map - Denison University
cards.access_notes: Available for student use and social events. Located on North Quad.

cards.title: Walk the College Cemetery
cards.subtitle: Historic campus grounds
cards.notes: Take a quiet walk through this historic site established in 1833. It is the final resting place for many of Denison's past presidents and professors.
cards.short_summary: A historic and peaceful campus cemetery dating back to 1833, reserved for university faculty.
cards.evidence_claim: Established in 1833, the College Cemetery is reserved for presidents and professors who wish to be interred on campus.
cards.source_title: Campus Map | Denison University
cards.access_notes: Open for public walking during daylight hours. Located on the hillside near the main campus.

boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: From the quiet stacks of Doane Library to the modern atriums of the Eisner Center, Denison University offers a variety of environments for focused academic work.

cards.title: The Study Tower
cards.subtitle: Quiet individual carrels in the library stacks
cards.notes: Find a private carrel in the 1981 'study tower' addition for deep focus. These spots are ideal for long-term research projects and silent individual work.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated vertical addition to the main library featuring quiet carrels for individual study.
cards.evidence_claim: The Seeley G. Mudd Learning Resources Center was added in 1981 and included construction of the 'study tower' for library resources and study.
cards.source_title: Denison Libraries | Campus Map
cards.access_notes: Open during library hours; swipe access required for late-night entry for students.

cards.entity_name: Michael D. Eisner Center for the Performing Arts
cards.title: Eisner Center Atrium
cards.subtitle: Modern collaborative spaces in the arts hub
cards.notes: Utilize the open seating areas designed for interdisciplinary interaction. The modern architecture provides a bright, energetic atmosphere for group projects.
cards.short_summary: Open, light-filled spaces within the performing arts center designed to encourage student collaboration.
cards.evidence_claim: The Eisner Center houses many open spaces especially configured to encourage interdisciplinary activity and interaction.
cards.source_title: Eisner Center for the Performing Arts - Denison University
cards.access_notes: Accessible during building operating hours; primarily used by students in the arts but open to all.

cards.title: Burton Morgan Atrium
cards.subtitle: Social and collaborative hub near career services
cards.notes: Work in the three-story atrium featuring breakout rooms and incubator spaces. It is a central spot for meeting peers between classes or career appointments.
cards.short_summary: A multi-story atrium with social spaces and breakout rooms for collaborative student work.
cards.evidence_claim: An atrium connects three floors; social spaces and smaller break-out rooms provide students with places to meet and work collaboratively.
cards.source_title: Designed to foster ideas and imagination. - GUND Partnership
cards.access_notes: Open during business and academic hours; houses the Knowlton Center for Career Exploration.

cards.title: Slivy's Cafe Lounge
cards.subtitle: Cozy fireplace seating in the student union
cards.notes: Grab a couch by the fireplace for a relaxed study session. This spot offers a comfortable, less formal environment compared to the library.
cards.short_summary: A cozy lounge area with a fireplace located within the student union's cafe space.
cards.evidence_claim: Slivy's Cafe lounge is described as a cozy area with couches in front of a fireplace, suitable for doing homework.
cards.source_title: My Top 5 Study Spots at Denison - Her Campus

cards.title: Talbot Hall Corner Windows
cards.subtitle: Scenic views from the top floors
cards.notes: Head to the 5th or 6th floors for tables positioned in corner windows. These spots offer some of the best views of Granville while you work.
cards.short_summary: High-elevation study tables in Talbot Hall providing expansive views of the surrounding landscape.
cards.evidence_claim: The 5th and 6th floors of Talbot Hall have tables and seating areas in the corner windows showcasing Granville scenery.
cards.source_title: My Top 5 Study Spots at Denison - Her Campus
cards.access_notes: Academic building; accessible during standard building hours for students.

cards.title: Curtis West Common Room
cards.subtitle: Traditional study hall with a fireplace
cards.notes: Study in a classic collegiate setting featuring wood-paneled walls and a fireplace. It provides a quiet, residential atmosphere for evening work.
cards.short_summary: A traditional wood-paneled common room in a residence hall used for quiet study.
cards.evidence_claim: Curtis West Hall features a quintessential common room with paneled walls, couches, study areas, and a cozy fireplace.
cards.source_title: Campus Map | Denison University
cards.access_notes: Located in a residence hall; primarily for residents but often accessible to students with card access.

cards.title: Hoaglin Outdoor Seating
cards.subtitle: Secluded high-rise tables behind the center
cards.notes: Find a quiet spot at the high-rise tables located behind the wellness center. This area is known for being peaceful and surrounded by greenery.
cards.short_summary: A secluded outdoor study area with high-rise tables located behind the Hoaglin Wellness Center.
cards.evidence_claim: There is a secluded area behind the wellness center with high-rise tables and other seating that is a nice place to study.
cards.source_title: My Top 5 Study Spots at Denison - Her Campus
cards.access_notes: Outdoor area; accessible 24/7, weather permitting.

cards.title: The Beach Patio
cards.subtitle: Outdoor cement patio with sunset views
cards.notes: Join friends for an outdoor session on this cement patio between Sawyer and Beaver halls. It is a popular spot for sunset views while finishing assignments.
cards.short_summary: A well-known outdoor cement patio area used by students for social studying and sunset viewing.
cards.evidence_claim: The Beach is the cement patio area in between Sawyer and Beaver, noted as a great place for outdoor study sessions.
cards.source_title: My Top 5 Study Spots at Denison - Her Campus
cards.access_notes: Outdoor space; accessible 24/7.

cards.title: Olin Maker Space
cards.subtitle: Creative and technical study environment
cards.notes: Work on technical projects in a space equipped with 3D printers and scientific collections. It is ideal for STEM students needing specialized equipment.
cards.short_summary: A maker space within the science hall featuring 3D printers and collaborative work areas.
cards.evidence_claim: Olin boasts a maker space including multiple 3-D printers and a large collection of rocks, fossils, and minerals.
cards.source_title: F.W. Olin Science Hall - Digital Exhibits
cards.access_notes: Accessible during building hours; some equipment may require training or supervision.

cards.title: Mulberry Computer Lab
cards.subtitle: Specialized lab for fine arts and design
cards.notes: Use this 17-seat lab for design and digital art projects. It is equipped with photo and design software relevant to the fine arts curriculum.
cards.short_summary: A specialized computer lab in the Bryant Arts Center for students working on digital design and arts.
cards.evidence_claim: Students have access to Mulberry Computer Lab, which has a 17 seat capacity for teaching and working in fine arts disciplines.
cards.source_title: Facilities | Visual Arts - Denison University
cards.access_notes: Open for student use when not occupied by classes; requires D-Card for building access.

cards.evidence_claim: Green Velvet is a featured retailer in Granville offering gifts, jewelry, and home items.
cards.source_title: Shop - Explore Granville
cards.access_notes: Open daily; located near the intersection of Broadway and Main.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Discover the unique rituals and annual events that define the Big Red experience on The Hill, from historic campus-wide holidays to senior send-off superstitions.

cards.title: D-Day
cards.subtitle: Annual Campus-Wide Celebration
cards.notes: Attend the university's longest-standing tradition featuring major musical acts and outdoor festivities. It evolved from the historic 1909 'Scrap Day' tug-of-war event.
cards.short_summary: D-Day is Denison's premier annual festival, dating back to 1909, featuring concerts and campus-wide celebrations.
cards.evidence_claim: D-Day is one of Denison's longest-standing annual events, dating back to 1909, and originated from a campus holiday called Scrap Day.
cards.source_title: D-Day: Behind the scenes - The Denisonian
cards.access_notes: Held annually on campus; specific dates and musical guests are announced by the Denison Campus Governance Association.

cards.title: The College Seal
cards.subtitle: Chapel Walk Superstition
cards.notes: Walk carefully along Chapel Walk in front of Swasey Chapel. Legend says if you step on the embedded college seal, you won't graduate on time.
cards.short_summary: A campus superstition warns students that stepping on the college seal in front of Swasey Chapel prevents graduation.
cards.evidence_claim: The story goes, if you step on the college seal embedded in Chapel Walk in front of Swasey Chapel, you won't graduate.
cards.source_title: Fun Times & Traditions at Denison | Student Organizations
cards.access_notes: Located outdoors on the main pedestrian path; accessible 24/7.

cards.title: Senior Sunrise
cards.subtitle: Commencement Morning Ritual
cards.notes: Gather with your class on the hill in front of the Sigma Chi house at dawn on Commencement day to watch the sun rise over Deeds Field.
cards.short_summary: Senior Sunrise is a sentimental graduation morning tradition where seniors gather on the hill to watch the sunrise together.
cards.evidence_claim: On their final morning at Denison, tearful seniors gather at the hill in front of Sigma Chi to watch the sunrise together.
cards.source_title: Live blog: Senior Send-Off 2024! | Commencement - Denison University
cards.access_notes: Occurs at dawn on the Saturday of Commencement weekend.

cards.title: Aestavalia
cards.subtitle: Spring Arts & Earth Festival
cards.notes: Celebrate the end of the spring semester on A-Quad with live music, inflatables, and local food trucks during this annual outdoor festival.
cards.short_summary: Aestavalia is an annual spring festival on the A-Quad featuring music, games, and community activities.
cards.evidence_claim: Aestavalia is an annual summer festival and earth day celebration featuring a community cookout, student performances, and inflatables.
cards.source_title: Aestavalia 2021 - Facebook
cards.access_notes: Typically held in late April on the Academic Quad (A-Quad).

cards.title: Induction Ceremony
cards.subtitle: First-Year Welcome Ritual
cards.notes: March along Chapel Walk behind your class banner to Reese~Shackelford Common to be officially welcomed by faculty in full academic regalia.
cards.short_summary: The Induction Ceremony is the formal welcome for incoming students, featuring a class banner procession and faculty greeting.
cards.evidence_claim: The Induction Ceremony involves students signing their class banner and processing along Chapel Walk to Reese~Shackelford Common.
cards.source_title: Denison welcomes Class of 2029 | First-Year Experience
cards.access_notes: Held during orientation week for all incoming first-year students.

cards.title: Major Day
cards.subtitle: Sophomore Declaration Celebration
cards.notes: Celebrate your academic path at the Provost's Dining Hall. Pick up custom class bracelets and meet with faculty after officially declaring your major.
cards.short_summary: Major Day is an annual rite of passage where sophomores celebrate declaring their academic majors with snacks and swag.
cards.evidence_claim: Major Day is an annual rite of passage for Denison sophomores where students celebrate their academic choices.
cards.source_title: Major Day: a Denison tradition | Article
cards.access_notes: Held annually in the spring for the sophomore class.

cards.title: The Homestead Cowbell
cards.subtitle: Sustainable Community Meal Ritual
cards.notes: Listen for the cowbell at the student-run Homestead. It signals the start of a communal vegetarian meal prepared on a wood-burning stove.
cards.short_summary: At the Homestead, a cowbell signals mealtimes where residents and guests circle up for a communal, sustainable dinner.
cards.evidence_claim: The cooks ring a cowbell to signal when the meal is ready, and everyone circles up, holding hands and taking a moment to reflect.
cards.source_title: Daily Life | Homestead - Denison University
cards.access_notes: Located at the Homestead; visitors are welcome for meals with prior arrangement.

cards.title: Changing the Light
cards.subtitle: Baccalaureate Candle Ritual
cards.notes: Participate in this solemn ritual at Swasey Chapel where seniors extinguish candles to symbolize their transition from students to alumni.
cards.short_summary: Changing the Light is a graduation ritual where seniors extinguish candles to represent spreading their light beyond The Hill.
cards.evidence_claim: At the end of Baccalaureate, each senior steps forward to extinguish a candle in Denison's ritual of Changing the Light.
cards.source_title: Live blog: Senior Send-Off 2025! | Commencement - Denison University
cards.access_notes: Held during the Baccalaureate services on Commencement Friday.

cards.title: The Primal Scream
cards.subtitle: Finals Week Stress Relief
cards.notes: Join fellow students outside your residence hall at midnight during finals week to release academic stress with a collective, loud scream.
cards.short_summary: The Primal Scream is a midnight finals week tradition where students gather outdoors to scream in unison.
cards.evidence_claim: During finals week, students pour out of their residence halls at midnight and share a primal scream.
cards.source_title: Fun Times & Traditions at Denison | Student Organizations
cards.access_notes: Occurs at midnight on a designated night during finals week; late-night event.

cards.title: Buzzy the Buzzard
cards.subtitle: Official Athletic Mascot
cards.notes: Find the university's mascot, Buzzy, at Big Red athletic events. He represents the 'Big Red' teams and is a staple for game-day photos.
cards.short_summary: Buzzy the Buzzard is the official mascot of Denison University, appearing at sports events to cheer on the Big Red.
cards.evidence_claim: Our athletic teams are the 'Big Red,' and our mascot is Buzzy the Buzzard.
cards.source_title: Fun Times & Traditions at Denison | Student Organizations
cards.access_notes: Appears at varsity athletic games and major campus spirit events.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at Denison University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: Build a plausible under-21-safe first-weekend sequence, not a ranking. Give each card one role in the sequence and use evergreen places or recurring behaviors rather than one-time events. Be conservative about hours, access, and travel time unless directly sourced.

cards.title: Move-In Day Arrival
cards.subtitle: Friday Morning Kickoff
cards.notes: Arrive at your assigned residence hall on East Quad. Student staff and athletes help unload boxes to get you settled into your new home on The Hill.
cards.short_summary: The official start of the first-year experience involving residence hall check-in and room setup.
cards.evidence_claim: Move-in for first-year students occurs on Friday, Aug. 21, 2026, at East Quad residence halls with assistance from community volunteers.
cards.source_title: Orientation Schedule | First-Year Experience - Denison University
cards.access_notes: Scheduled time slots are assigned to students in July for Friday morning arrival.

cards.title: First Campus Lunch
cards.subtitle: Friday Midday Fuel
cards.notes: Head to Huffman for an all-you-care-to-eat meal. It is a primary gathering spot for students living on the East Quad during their first weekend.
cards.short_summary: A central dining facility on the East Quad serving locally infused flavors and diverse menu options.
cards.evidence_claim: Huffman Dining Hall is listed as a primary lunch location for students and families during orientation Friday.
cards.source_title: Family Orientation Programming | First-Year Experience - Denison University
cards.access_notes: Open for lunch from 11:30 a.m. to 2:30 p.m. during move-in day.

cards.title: The Induction Ceremony
cards.subtitle: Friday Evening Tradition
cards.notes: Walk through lines of applauding faculty into the wisteria-bordered oval. This formal welcome marks your official entry into the Denison community.
cards.short_summary: A formal ceremony where the president and faculty welcome the new class to the university.
cards.evidence_claim: The Induction Ceremony is held on Friday evening at Reese~Shackelford Common to formally welcome the newest Denisonians.
cards.source_title: Welcome to the Class of 2028 | What's Happening - Denison University
cards.access_notes: Attendance is expected for all first-year students as part of orientation.

cards.title: Late Night at Slayter
cards.subtitle: Friday Night Social
cards.notes: Visit the heart of campus for snacks and socializing. It is the go-to spot for evening events and meeting fellow new students after move-in.
cards.short_summary: The student union building featuring dining, the campus bookstore, and student organization spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Slayter Union hosts dessert and farewell events for families and students on the first night of orientation.
cards.source_title: Fun Times & Traditions at Denison | Student Organizations
cards.access_notes: Open late for student programming; specific hours vary by vendor inside.

cards.title: Morning Trail Walk
cards.subtitle: Saturday Morning Exploration
cards.notes: Explore 350 acres of beech-maple forest just north of campus. The well-marked trails are perfect for a quiet walk to clear your head before sessions.
cards.short_summary: A massive natural area used for research and recreation, featuring diverse Ohio flora and fauna.
cards.evidence_claim: The Bio Reserve is open to the public from dawn to dusk every day and is within walking distance of campus.
cards.source_title: Biological Reserve | Sustainability - Denison University
cards.access_notes: Open dawn to dusk; dogs must be on a leash.

cards.title: The Granville Tradition
cards.subtitle: Saturday Afternoon Treat
cards.notes: Walk down the hill into Granville for a scoop of fresh-made custard. It is a staple for students and the original home of the franchise.
cards.short_summary: A local favorite ice cream shop in downtown Granville known for its daily-made frozen custard.
cards.evidence_claim: Whit's Frozen Custard in Granville is the original location and a popular destination for Denison students during breaks.
cards.source_title: Ohio - Granville | Whit's Frozen Custard
cards.access_notes: Located on the main village street, a short walk from the campus entrance.

cards.title: Recreation and Fitness
cards.subtitle: Saturday Afternoon Activity
cards.notes: Check out the Crown Fitness Center or the Trumbull Aquatics Center. It is the best place to stay active and meet other students interested in sports.
cards.short_summary: The primary athletic and recreation facility on campus, housing the gym, pool, and indoor track.
cards.evidence_claim: The Mitchell Center and Crown Fitness Center offer weekend hours for students to utilize recreation services.
cards.source_title: Mitchell Center Hours - Denison University
cards.access_notes: Students must swipe their ID card for access; Saturday hours are typically 8:00 AM – 7:00 PM.

cards.title: Sustainable Living Tour
cards.subtitle: Sunday Morning Discovery
cards.notes: Take a peaceful walk to this student-run sustainable community. Visit during a Saturday work party or Sunday open house to see off-the-grid living.
cards.short_summary: A residential learning community focused on sustainability and communal living since 1977.
cards.evidence_claim: The Homestead welcomes visitors and offers Saturday morning work parties where everyone is welcome to help in the gardens.
cards.source_title: Visit | Homestead - Denison University
cards.access_notes: Located at 1385 North Street; visitors are asked to walk from the recycling center parking lot.

cards.title: Sunday Brunch
cards.subtitle: Sunday Midday Tradition
cards.notes: Enjoy a relaxed brunch at 'The Table at Curtis' on the North Quad. It is a favorite weekend spot for students to catch up after their first few days.
cards.short_summary: A major dining hall on the North Quad offering diverse food stations and social seating.
cards.evidence_claim: Curtis Dining Hall is a primary all-you-care-to-eat space on campus serving students and the community.
cards.source_title: Dining | Denison University
cards.access_notes: Open for brunch and dinner on weekends; check the Denison Hospitality site for specific Sunday hours.

cards.title: Find Your Study Spot
cards.subtitle: Sunday Evening Prep
cards.notes: Scope out the library to find your favorite 'nook' before classes start. It is a quiet place to organize your syllabus and prepare for Monday.
cards.short_summary: The main academic resource center providing study spaces, research help, and extensive collections.
cards.evidence_claim: The library is open on Sundays from 10:30 a.m. to midnight during the academic year.
cards.source_title: Hours | Library - Denison University
cards.access_notes: Open until midnight on Sundays; students can use their ID for access to various facilities.
